title: Choosing Surgery After Years of Hesitation
paragraphs: Selama beberapa tahun, Junaidi menunda operasi yang pernah dibahas bersama tim perawatannya. Ia mengelola gejalanya dengan pengobatan, tetapi khawatir tentang pemulihan dan tanggung jawab keluarga. Ketika gejalanya berubah, ia kembali bertemu spesialis dan bertanya tentang pilihan, risiko, serta masa pemulihan. Spesialis itu membantunya memahami apa yang mungkin terjadi pada setiap pilihan.

Setelah berdiskusi dengan keluarga dan tim medisnya, Junaidi memilih operasi. Saudaranya setuju membantu di rumah selama masa pemulihan. Setelah pulih, Junaidi lega karena telah mencari informasi dan dukungan yang jelas. Ia belajar bahwa keputusan kesehatan yang sulit dapat dihadapi selangkah demi selangkah.
answerKey: For several years, Junaidi delayed a surgery that his care team had discussed with him. He managed his symptoms with treatment, but worried about recovery and family responsibilities. When his symptoms changed, he met a specialist again and asked questions about the available options, risks, and recovery. The specialist helped him understand what each choice could involve. After discussing the decision with his family and medical team, Junaidi chose surgery. His brother agreed to help at home during the recovery period. After recovering, Junaidi felt relieved that he had sought clear information and support. He learned that difficult health decisions are easier to face step by step.
